title: Understanding Matrix Dimensions
text: In an OLS model, the design matrix X typically has dimensions $$n$$ by $$p+1$$, where $$n$$ is the number of observations and $$p+1$$ accounts for the intercept and $$p$$ features.

title: Dimensions of Theta
text: The parameter vector theta (θ) in an OLS model should have dimensions $$p+1$$ by $$1$$, corresponding to the $$p+1$$ features including the intercept.

title: Checking Matrix Multiplication Compatibility
text: For matrix multiplication to be valid, the number of columns in the first matrix must equal the number of rows in the second matrix. Given X is $$n$$ by $$p+1$$ and θ is $$p+1$$ by $$1$$, is the multiplication Xθ valid?

title: Verifying the Output Dimensions
text: After multiplying X (n by (p+1)) with θ ((p+1) by 1), what should be the dimensions of the resulting matrix?

title: Conclusion on Matrix Dimensions
text: Given the dimensions of X and θ, the resulting matrix from Xθ should have dimensions $$n$$ by $$1$$, representing the predicted values for each observation.
